_doc: Plan de fotos de catálogo (estándar: estudio gris 4:5 en modelo musculoso). Lo usa photos-run.cjs. Cada producto: referencias (primero la más fiel: foto real > vector > Shopify), horma real de la base, estampado, modelo y tomas. Una toma 'photoshoot' cuesta 2 créditos y da 4 fotos; 'single' 1 crédito por imagen.

defaults.directions: Premium e-commerce catalog photo for a Colombian gym-wear brand. Seamless soft light-grey studio sweep, broad even soft light, subtle floor shadow. The model is a visibly muscular fitness athlete (gym bodybuilder build, not a slim fashion model): very broad shoulders and traps, big defined biceps and forearms filling the sleeves, thick chest, lean waist, confident relaxed expression. Hair must never cover the print. He wears {outfit}, no jewelry, no other logos. GARMENT: {garment}. PRINT: {print}. Reproduce the garment exactly as in the reference photos: same base color, same fabric texture, same print artwork, lettering, size and placement. Do not invent, remove, mirror or alter any logo, text or graphic. The garment fits exactly as described (do not make it tighter or looser). {extra} Only one garment in the scene, worn by the model: no clothing rack, no hanger, no second or floating garment. No props, no added text, no watermark.

garments.oversized200: heavyweight cotton oversized t-shirt (200 g), boxy fit with dropped shoulders and wide short sleeves reaching the elbow, hem at hip level
garments.slim: fitted slim-fit cotton-stretch t-shirt that hugs the chest, shoulders and arms, short sleeves tight around the biceps, straight hem at the hip; the seams are stitched tone-on-tone in the same color as the fabric (no contrast piping)
garments.c4tank: sleeveless tank made from a 200 g regular-fit cotton t-shirt with the sleeves cut off just outside the shoulder seam (clean raw cut edges, moderately deep armholes), hem at hip level
garments.oversizedTank: sleeveless tank made from a 200 g oversized cotton t-shirt with the sleeves cut off (wide raw-cut armholes showing the sides of the torso), boxy cut, hem at hip level
garments.hugeTank: boxy sleeveless tank made from a heavyweight acid-wash oversized t-shirt with the sleeves removed at the dropped shoulder seam (wide raw-cut armholes), wide straight body, hem at hip level well below the waistband (NOT cropped), exactly like the fit reference photo of the man seen from the back
garments.croppedAcid: heavyweight acid-wash oversized cotton t-shirt (220 g) in washed black with strong light-grey marbled mottling (fabric color exactly like the acid-black reference flat-lay photo), boxy with dropped shoulders and wide short sleeves; the body is shortened so the hem ends about 5 cm below the waistband of the joggers (slightly cropped, not a crop top), with a raw scissor-cut bottom edge (unfinished, no stitched hem, slightly uneven)
garments.hugeTankPlain: boxy sleeveless tank made from a heavyweight 200 g cotton oversized t-shirt with the sleeves removed at the dropped shoulder seam (wide raw-cut armholes), wide straight body, hem at hip level well below the waistband (NOT cropped), exactly like the fit reference photo of the man seen from the back
garments.acidTee: heavyweight acid-wash oversized cotton t-shirt (220 g), boxy fit with dropped shoulders and wide short sleeves reaching the elbow, hem at hip level
garments.acidTeeShort: heavyweight acid-wash oversized cotton t-shirt (220 g), boxy fit with dropped shoulders and wide short sleeves, body slightly shortened so the clean hem sits at the top of the hips
garments.acidTank: heavyweight acid-wash oversized sleeveless tank with the sleeves removed at the dropped shoulder seam (wide raw-cut armholes), boxy and wide, hem at hip level
